item.text: probe_exploit Opens with a defection probe, then cooperates once to identify immediate retaliation. It exploits opponents that continue cooperating, while reverting to reciprocal play against retaliatory opponents such as tit-for-tat. ```python # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def policy(own_history, opponent_history): if len(opponent_history) == 0: return 1 elif len(opponent_history) == 1: return 0 elif opponent_history[1] == 0: return 1 else: return opponent_history[-1] # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END ```
